title: Proof-site configuration (site/site.config.json) — PROPOSED
description: Every per-site value of a tangentproofs proof site in one file (CONVENTIONS.md §3). Today these are constants at the top of app.js / build_decls.py / ExtractDecls.lean; star-height values shown as examples.

title.description: Short site title, e.g. 'Star height ≤ 3, informalized'.

siteDir.description: Folder holding the site (learn/ only when site/ is taken).

leanRoots.description: Repo-relative Lean source dirs; CI path filters and source rendering use these.

namespace.description: Prefix stripped to form node ids, e.g. 'OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.'.

modulePrefix.description: Modules counted as the project, e.g. 'OAI.Computability.StarHeight'.

headlines.description: Headline theorem ids, main first. Red border on the graph; heads of the statement set; cards on #/start.

conditional.description: Headline id -> names of open hypotheses it is conditional on (shown as CONDITIONAL).

mathlibGloss.description: Mathlib name -> one-line HTML gloss for the Start here page.

progressKey.description: localStorage key; never rename once published (e.g. 'star-height-progress-v1').

understand.description: Understanding checkbox label; a short form like 'Understood' is allowed.

start.default: Start here: what the theorem says

sourceBase.description: Where rendered Lean source pages live relative to the site root (eulers-gem: '../docs/').

credit.description: Footer credit HTML (author of the proof, licence).

trust.description: Data for #/trust: per-headline axiom lists, what was re-checked where.
